note: Aucune stratégie n'est recommandée pour le trading réel (voir rapport).

PREFADE-S.vwap: session VWAP anchored 18:00 ET, price=(H+L+C)/3, weights=tick volume
PREFADE-S.bands: vwap +/- L * sigma, sigma = sqrt(cum w var of price around running vwap)
PREFADE-S.setup: first/any touch of the 2.0 sigma band between 07:30:00 and 09:29:59 ET
PREFADE-S.entry: market at next 1-min open, direction = toward VWAP (fade)
PREFADE-S.target: dynamic session VWAP (limit re-priced each bar)
PREFADE-S.no_trade: outside 07:30-09:30 ET window; sigma warmup < 25 bars
